mdsa-tools Python API#

The API currently consists of five main modules

mdsa_tools.Data_gen_hbond

A module for creating and manipulating systems representations of molecular dynamics trajectories.

mdsa_tools.Analysis

Mostly functions as a big wrapper for conveniently storing a lot of our analysis methods.

mdsa_tools.msm_modeler

Use results of systems analysis as candidate states for MarkovStateModel Kinetics analysis (or foundations of) - cluster pca/umap embeddings at different target n_dimensions, - or pull H-bond values via systems_analysis.extract_hbond_values() and use those in replicate maps instead of k-means labels.

mdsa_tools.Cpptraj_import

This module provides utilities for importing and structuring hydrogen bond data generated by cpptraj.

mdsa_tools.Viz

Mostly functions as a big wrapper for conveniently storing a lot of our analysis methods.
